answer: A mechanism that actually bites: let the challenge probing adapt: it keeps issuing tasks the fleet already failed, because copper only stays cheap while repeat infrastructure gets no useful signal and its pass rate degrades each epoch. Concretely, tundra is enforced in the ledger: Jurors see the identity's full answer chain, so a template match is detectable in one pass. Any spiral approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. Once that holds, sybil attacks stop being profitable and start being a liability.
